title: Sequential chromatin immunoprecipitation protocol for global analysis through massive parallel sequencing \(reChIP-seq)
protocol: Dialyse 150 µg of antibody overnight against 1xPBS if stored in primary amine buffers like glycin or Tris (optional).
Quantify the amount of antibody recovered from the dialysis step using Bradford assay.
Wash 250 µl protein A sepharose beads twice with 500 µl sodium borate washing solution.
Dilute the antibody 1/1 with Sodium Borate washing solution.
Add diluted antibody into prewashed protein A beads and incubate for 1 hour at room temperature.
Centrifuge the protein A/antibody mix at 425xg.
Recover the supernatant and quantify the amount of antibody that was not crosslinked.
Wash the crosslinked beads with sodium borate washing solution.
Resuspend 1.625mg DSS in 250µl dimethylsulfoxide or dimethylformamide.
Add 250µl PBS to the DSS solution and immediately add it into the preloaded protein-A beads.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 hour on a rotating table.
Wash the crosslinked beads twice with 1xPBS.
Add 1ml ethanolamine (0.1M) to inactivate remaining DSS.
Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
To remove non-crosslinked antibodies, add 1ml of glycine (0.1M, pH 2.8).
Vortex briefly and recover the supernatant in 25µl Tris-base (1M, pH 8.8) to neutralize acidic conditions.
Quantify the amount of antibody in the supernatant to estimate crosslinking efficiency.
Wash crosslinked beads twice with sodium borate washing solution.
Resuspend in 500µl PBS for storage at 4°C.
Pool at least four primary ChIPs done with DSS crosslinked antibodies.
Elute the first IP with 10 mM DTT at 30°C for 30 minutes.
Combine eluates from the first IP before proceeding to the second IP.
Dilute combined eluates at least 30-times with ChIP lysis buffer.
Use the smallest possible volume of elution buffer for reChIP elution.
From a typical reChIP eluate, keep 14 μl for LinDA amplification and take the remaining 16 μl for qPCR validations.

Perform qPCR validations with at least 2 technical replicates per evaluated region using 2 μl DNA, 1 μl of 10 uM primers mix, and 5 μl of Quantitect SyBr master mix (total volume: 10 μl per reaction).
Take 14 μl of the reChIP material for linear DNA amplification following the corresponding protocol.
Evaluate the amplified material by qPCR as indicated in step 2.
Perform library preparation for massive parallel sequencing by following standard conditions.
